alex: Quick follow-up to the RFC about a lightweight probe/manifest handshake for hosted/dedicated/private. want to capture tradeoffs and rollout steps.

maria: sounds useful. what's the minimum handshake? single roundtrip or a streaming exchange?

alex: minimal: client does a probe with a short probe-token -> runtime returns capability manifest (public fields only). no secret rebinding. full flows still need normal auth.

jamal: how do we avoid giving away infra or region ids to regulated tenants? private deployments are sensitive.

alex: manifest fields are labeled with scope: public|private. public is safe for the app; private requires control-plane mediated exchange after full auth. example public manifest snippet:

```
{"version":"v1","capabilities":["kv_cache","streaming","quant_profiles"],"compatibility":{"kv_cache":"compat"}}
```

sri: need versioning + checksum. otherwise client cached manifest might be stale and cause routing to incompatible runtime.

maria: +1. also add "min_client_version" and a "grace_window_seconds" field so SDKs can decide optimistic routing behavior.

elaine: for sidecarless private installs, ops want zero unauthenticated probes. can the probe be opt-in per-tenant?

alex: yes. manifest discovery is optional. control plane can mark tenant policy: discovery=enabled|disabled. if disabled, SDK falls back to configured route only.

jamal: fallback semantics: we must avoid state drift. declare stateful things (kv_cache, prefix_sharing) with compatibility levels: strict, compat, none. routing will only fallback if compatibility != strict.

sri: and document eviction semantics and expected divergence window.

maria: observability contract: when a manifest changes for a tenant, emit an event to Console and create an incident-like alert to owning team. autoswitch to a vetted fallback for X minutes.

ops-bot: deploy:ambient-manifest-v1 succeeded at 2026-03-22T15:04Z :white_check_mark:

elaine: telemetry PII risk again: manifest should not surface bare hostnames or az ids. use abstracted region tags: "region:eu" not "eu-west-1b".

alex: agreed. manifest schema will enforce redaction rules. also include a "sensitive_fields" list which is only returned after auth via control plane.

jamal: SDK behavior: cache last-known manifest with TTL and perform async revalidate. optimistic-mode header "X-Manifest-Fresh: stale|fresh" for runtime to make routing decisions.

sri: rollout plan: feature-flag handshake_version=v1. start with internal tenants, then opt-in customers, then global. clients must accept min_version or use safe default.

maria: runbook: on manifest mismatch, route to fallback for 5 minutes, notify on-call, then require manual acknowledgement to re-enable automatic routing.

elaine: security review request: I'll need schema + examples and list of fields allowed in public scope.

alex: will post RFC patch with the manifest schema + compatibility matrix. thanks for the rapid feedback. :pray:
